corrections.old_text: [፭] ኢሳ ፷፩ ፥ ፪ እንደግያነ በቀል የ↵
corrections.corrected_text: [፭] ኢሳ ፷፩ ፥ ፪ ፡ ነደግያነ በቀል የ↵
corrections.reason: The word-separator colon (፡) after ፪ followed by 1st-order ነ was misread as እን; philologically 'ነደግያነ በቀል' (those who have abandoned/forsaken vengeance, from Ge'ez ነደገ) is the standard Andemta gloss for የዋሀን.
The printed glyph is 6th-order ን (ከተመገብን, parallel to L18 ከተመገብን), not 1st-order ነ.
The printed glyph has the 5th-order loop (ቴ) for Ge'ez 'ስቴ ኃጢአት' (drink of sin, paired with መብልዓ ኃጢአት), misread as 3rd-order ቲ.
